title: lead_register
description: Memory block written by Agent 5.3 (Lead Capture + Nurture, Layer 5 — Distribution). The live, HubSpot-synced register of every inbound lead processed in a run: normalized contact, lead score + breakdown, temperature, routing decision, matched audience segment, CRM sync status, and (for warm/cold) the approved message_flows flow it was enrolled into. Hot leads are flagged for a human (hot_leads_for_human) without blocking the warm/cold automation. Read by Layer 6 (6.1 Performance Analytics attributes lead volume/CPL/conversion). Human gate: conditional — gate_status defaults to 'auto_approved'; hot leads are a notification, not a gate. | Depends on: audience_segments (1.2), message_flows (4.4), client_profile (DEL-17). | First authored: 2026-05-29.

score_breakdown.description: Points awarded per scoring factor (auditable). Components should sum to `score`.

lead_id.description: Stable id for this lead within the register. Format: lead-{slug}.

source.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. meta_lead_form / landing_page / whatsapp / referral / chat.

market.description: Inferred target market: Mexico / Colombia / Dominican Republic / Puerto Rico.

contact.description: Normalized contact details. PII — operator-facing only.

segment_id.description: Best-fit audience_segments segment_id (seg-...), or null if no segment fits.

score.description: Lead score 0-100 from the scoring model in the system prompt.

temperature.description: hot = score>=70 or explicit high-intent action | warm = 40-69 | cold = <40 | disqualified = clear non-lead.

routing.description: Action taken: human_followup (hot) | nurture (warm/cold enrolled in a flow) | hold (kept in CRM, no flow) | disqualified.

enrolled_flow_id.description: message_flows flow_id (flow-...) this lead was enrolled into. Null for human_followup / hold / disqualified, or when no approved flow fit.

crm_action.description: HubSpot write action chosen after dedupe.

crm_status.description: Result of the HubSpot sync for this lead. 'synced'/'pending' for create|update; 'skipped' pairs with crm_action 'skip' (no sync attempted, e.g. a disqualified test submission); 'failed' on any lead should drive gate_status toward pending_review.

crm_object_id.description: HubSpot contact/object id when known; null while pending.

rationale.description: One short EN sentence: why this score/temperature/routing.

reason.description: One-line EN reason this lead is flagged hot for a human.

client_id.description: Client this lead register belongs to. Lowercase-hyphenated. Example: acme-co.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime this run's lead_register batch was produced.

gate_status.description: Conditional human gate. Defaults to 'auto_approved' (routine batch is autonomous). 'pending_review' when CRM sync failed / scoring unreliable / message_flows missing; 'blocked' when there are no usable inbound leads (leads: []). Hot leads are flagged in hot_leads_for_human and do NOT by themselves change this from auto_approved.

lifecycle_stage.description: Carried from client_profile; affects expected lead volume and benchmark thresholds.

batch_window.description: The incremental window this batch covers, e.g. '2026-06-01T09:00Z/PT15M' or a human label. Null if not tracked.

markets.description: Target markets represented in this batch (MX/CO/DR/PR).

leads.description: Every lead processed in this run. May be empty only when gate_status is 'blocked'.

hot_leads_for_human.description: Hot leads flagged for immediate human follow-up. Non-empty is normal and does NOT change gate_status from auto_approved.

total_leads.description: Count of leads in the `leads` array. The summary must foot to it.

by_temperature.description: Count of leads per temperature, e.g. {"hot": 1, "warm": 2, "cold": 1}.

by_routing.description: Count of leads per routing action.

enrolled_count.description: Warm/cold leads enrolled into a nurture flow.

hot_count.description: Leads routed to human_followup. Must equal len(hot_leads_for_human).

routing_notes.description: EN — assumptions, dedupe merges, unscoreable leads, missing/unapproved flows, CRM failures, blocked reasons.
